comment: SpEdE UI configuration. Copy this file to config.json next to server.py (or point SPEDE_CONFIG at a copy). Every scalar key can be overridden by SPEDE_<KEY> in the environment, e.g. SPEDE_COMFY_ROOT; scenes is read from this file only. Every scene needs hero, source_ply and cameras. Scene paths are relative to scene_root unless absolute. comfy_host/comfy_port is the raw ComfyUI server (its /system_stats says it is alive); comfy_sdk_url is the comfy-api-proxy in front of it; comfy_root is the ComfyUI directory whose output/ folder receives the results. gpu_turns is the owner's shared-GPU turn system and stays off elsewhere. patch_mode=depthfill (the default) rebuilds the hidden surface on MoGe depth aligned to the scene; patch_mode=patch is the planar fallback. allround_mode=independent (the default) is the all-around fill that cleans every camera on its own with Qwen-Image 2.1 turbo and fits the fill to all of them at once; allround_mode=progressive cleans one camera at a time (slower); allround_mode=orbit is the experimental MiniMax H3 orbit-video path.
accept_qwen_research_license_comment: Qwen-Image 2.1 and its Qwen3-VL text encoder are Research License models: read https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE and set accept_qwen_research_license to true only for permitted local use. Downloading the weights does not grant commercial rights to the output. Without it Remove, the all-around fill and a hero check that Qwen3-VL names are refused; Extract and a hero check with a typed name still run.
